name: Ovoid Jar with Yellow Glaze
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably Kangxi period, 1662-1722；Monochrome enameled porcelain: porcelain with yellow enamel on the exterior and clear glaze on the interior; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Da Qing Kangxi nian zhi" on the base
